text.en:
Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, the members of the crew of any
vessel of the Bureau of Coast and Geodetic Survey shall be 1 entitled to pay for not more than sixty days
when they are sick in a hospital, in accordance with the United States regulations for Coast and Geodetic
Survey vessels.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-seven.
Approved, November 18, 1936.
